Each numbered page that follows contains the current presentation image, its caption and the clean-capture filename. Presentation PNGs are 2560 × 1920; raw captures keep their native dimensions. Monitoring and usage presentations use detail crops for readability, with the original full captures also included. Capture dates describe the original screenshots, not this document revision.
